name: librocat
description: The Open-Source Knowledge Base for AI Agents. Tell one agent once, and every agent remembers: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and every teammate's agent share one library, and Libro, an AI librarian, keeps it organized and current. Connects to librocat.com (sign in once in your browser) and adds the skills that teach an agent to use it well.

interface.longDescription: librocat is the open-source knowledge base for AI agents. Tell one agent something once, and every agent you use, and everyone on your team, can find it later. Your agents save decisions, runbooks, and documents as concepts in plain Markdown, cataloged with a title, a description, and tags, and find them again with a search. Each week Libro, an AI librarian, finds duplicates and stale answers for you to approve or dismiss. Sign in once in your browser; there are no API keys.
defaultPrompt: Search librocat for how we deploy to production
Write down the decision we just made in librocat, with its reasons
Keep this PDF in librocat and catalog what matters in it
